rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken expression for something that gives people pleasure or makes them happy.

example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 lai5 mat6 ling6 jan4 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use this when something is pleasing because it suits someone's taste or preferences.

example.english: This design is pleasing to me.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cit3 gai3 hou2 ngaam1 sam1 seoi2

rows.note: Use this for something pleasing or attractive in appearance, especially a design or visual result.

example.english: The new décor in your home is pleasing to look at.
example.jyutping: nei5 gaan1 uk1 ge3 san1 zong1 sau1 hou2 tai2
